MALAYSIA DEPOSIT INSURANCE CORPORATION ACT 2011

MALAYSIA DEPOSIT INSURANCE CORPORATION (FIRST PREMIUM AND ANNUAL
PREMIUM IN RESPECT OF INSURER MEMBERS) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2020

IN exercise of the p owers conferred by paragraph 71(1) (b) and subsections 72(2)
and (3) of the Malaysia Deposit Insurance Corporation Act 2011 [ Act 720], the Minister,
on the recommendation of the Corporation, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1.  (1)  This order may be cited as the Malaysia Deposit Insurance Corporation
(First Premium and Annual Premium in respect of Insurer Members)
(Amendment) Order 2020.

(2)  Paragraph 2 shall have effect from the assessment year of 2020.

(3) Paragraph 3 shal l have effect for the assessment year of 2020 and the
assessment year of 2021.

Deletion of paragraph 13
2. The Malaysia Deposit Insurance Corporation ( First Premium and Annual
Premium in respect of Insurer Members) Order 2016 [P.U. (A) 49/2016 ], which is
referred to as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended by deleting paragraph 13.

Amendment of Schedules
3. The principal Order is amended  by substituting for the First Schedule,
Second Schedule, Third Schedule, Fourth Sc hedule an d Fifth Schedule the
